∀ (τ : ℝ) (a b c : ℤ), 0 < τ →
  KdVPlan.Interaction a b c (-(a+b+c)) → a+b ≠ 0 →
  let k := a+b+c
  let E := ‖KdVPlan.eta τ (3*(a:ℝ)*(b:ℝ)*(a+b:ℤ)) (3*(k:ℝ)*(c:ℝ)*(a+b:ℤ))‖
  E / |(k:ℝ)| ≤ 6 / KdVPlan.n3 a b c (-k) ∧
  (E / |(k:ℝ)|) / |(a:ℝ)*(b:ℝ)*(c:ℝ)| ≤ 18*τ / KdVPlan.n3 a b c (-k)
proof:
intro τ a b c hτ hi hp
dsimp only
let k : ℤ := a+b+c
have ha : (a:ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hi.2.1
have hb : (b:ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hi.2.2.1
have hc : (c:ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hi.2.2.2.1
have hkz : k ≠ 0 := by
  intro hz
  exact hi.2.2.2.2 (by change -k = 0; rw [hz, neg_zero])
have hk : (k:ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hkz
have hp' : ((a+b:ℤ):ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hp
let A : ℝ := |(a:ℝ)*(b:ℝ)|
let B : ℝ := |(c:ℝ)*(k:ℝ)|
let P : ℝ := |((a+b:ℤ):ℝ)|
let K : ℝ := |(k:ℝ)|
let Q : ℝ := |(a:ℝ)*(b:ℝ)*(c:ℝ)|
let N : ℝ := KdVPlan.n3 a b c (-k)
let α : ℝ := 3*(a:ℝ)*(b:ℝ)*(a+b:ℤ)
let β : ℝ := 3*(k:ℝ)*(c:ℝ)*(a+b:ℤ)
let E : ℝ := ‖KdVPlan.eta τ α β‖
have hA : 0 < A := abs_pos.mpr (mul_ne_zero ha hb)
have hB : 0 < B := abs_pos.mpr (mul_ne_zero hc hk)
have hP : 0 < P := abs_pos.mpr hp'
have hK : 0 < K := abs_pos.mpr hk
have hQ : 0 < Q := abs_pos.mpr (mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero ha hb) hc)
have hα : |α| = 3*A*P := by
  dsimp [α, A, P]
  simp only [abs_mul, abs_ofNat]
  ring
have hβ : |β| = 3*B*P := by
  dsimp [β, B, P]
  simp only [abs_mul, abs_ofNat]
  ring
have hphase : α*β ≠ 0 := by
  apply mul_ne_zero
  · dsimp [α]; exact mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) ha) hb) hp'
  · dsimp [β]; exact mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) hk) hc) hp'
have he := (h_T002 τ α β hτ).2 hphase
have hr1 : |α/β| = A/B := by
  rw [abs_div, hα, hβ]
  field_simp
have hr2 : |β/α| = B/A := by
  rw [abs_div, hα, hβ]
  field_simp
have hsmall : min |α| |β| = 3*P*min A B := by
  rw [hα, hβ]
  simpa [mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using
    (mul_min_of_nonneg (show 0 ≤ 3*P by positivity) A B).symm
have hf := h_T003.1 a b c (-k) hi
have hf0 : (1/K)*min (A/B) (B/A) ≤ 3/N := by
  simpa [K, A, B, N, Int.cast_neg, abs_neg, mul_neg, abs_mul, mul_comm] using hf.2.1
have hf1 : P / max A B ≤ 6/N := by
  simpa [P, A, B, N, Int.cast_add, Int.cast_neg, abs_neg, mul_neg, abs_mul, mul_comm] using hf.2.2
have hprod : K*Q = A*B := by
  dsimp [K, Q, A, B]
  simp only [abs_mul]
  ring
have he0 : E ≤ 2*min (A/B) (B/A) := by simpa [E, hr1, hr2] using he.1
have he1 : E ≤ τ*(3*P*min A B) := by simpa [E, hsmall] using he.2
constructor
· calc
    E / K ≤ (2*min (A/B) (B/A))/K := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right he0 hK.le
    _ = 2*((1/K)*min (A/B) (B/A)) := by ring
    _ ≤ 2*(3/N) := by linarith
    _ = 6/N := by ring
· have hm : min A B / (A*B) = 1 / max A B := by
    rcases le_total A B with hab | hba
    · rw [min_eq_left hab, max_eq_right hab]; field_simp
    · rw [min_eq_right hba, max_eq_left hba]; field_simp
  calc
    (E/K)/Q = E/(A*B) := by rw [div_div, hprod]
    _ ≤ (τ*(3*P*min A B))/(A*B) := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right he1 (by positivity)
    _ = 3*τ*(P/max A B) := by
      calc
        _ = 3*τ*P*(min A B/(A*B)) := by ring
        _ = _ := by rw [hm]; ring
    _ ≤ 3*τ*(6/N) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hf1 (by positivity)
    _ = 18*τ/N := by ring
